paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: direct model picker with favorites and an aurora reasoning-effort slider
# dsh-iridescent-model-selector
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) client plugin that replaces the model button in the composer with its own
picker: the current model and reasoning effort sit on the button, and one panel holds the model lis
t, your favorite models, and a reasoning-effort slider.
## Features
- **Direct model picking.** One panel lists every model from the harness's own model catalog, groupe
d by provider. A search field appears when more than four models are available. Clicking a row switc
hes the session's model for the next request and keeps the panel open, so you can adjust the reasoni

ng effort in the same pass.
- **Favorites.** Hover a row and click the star to pin a model to a Favo

rites group at the top of the list. Up to 24 favorites are kept in the browser's local storage.
- **
Reasoning-effort slider.** The slider has one stop for each effort level the selected model advertis
es. A continuous aurora gradient (cyan → blue → violet → rose) reveals more of its spectrum at highe
r levels, with a glow and a light sweep that grow with the level. Release the thumb or click a level

name to apply it.
- **Per-model effort memory.** The last effort you used with each provider/model

pair is restored when you switch back to that model, if the model still offers it.
- **Native fallba
ck.** The plugin takes the composer's model seat at a higher priority instead of removing the built-
in selector. The built-in selector stays registered underneath and shows again when this plugin is d

isabled or uninstalled. The `/model` command is unaffected.
- Keyboard support (↑/↓ through models,
Enter in search picks the first match, Esc closes), IME-safe input, Chinese and English UI, and `pre
fers-reduced-motion` support.
## Compatibility
Tested on **DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 and 0.2.1-rc.5** (`engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.
on **DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 and 0.2.1-rc.5** (`engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`).
The plugin reads the per-session model directory (`modelDirectories`) that the built-in `@deepseek-a
i/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` plugin provides. That service is an internal detail of the harness,
so a later harness release can change it. Keep the built-in model-selection plugin enabled; this pl
ugin does nothing without it.

Desktop: install from the same Git URL through the app's plugin manager (or a plugin market such as
dsh-market once it lists this plugin).
To go back to the built-in selector, disable or uninstall the plugin.
## Notes
- Model and effort changes go through the harness's normal session model selection. A step that is a

lready running keeps the model and effort it started with.
- Favorites and remembered efforts live i
n the browser's `localStorage` for the DSH page, so they are per machine and are not synced.
